review.authorization: Active goal and standing autonomous approval for documented native screening reconstructions.
review.basis: Allocated source oil mass reconstructed on complete native oil power-plant service, original 9% penalty and 90% combustion-only capture. Limestone-treatment CO2 remains uncaptured.
limitations: Reconstruct allocated useful oil CHP heat on complete native German heavy-fuel-oil power-plant combustion. UVEK lacks a direct oil CHP heat supplier. The derived 0.3829528198799506 MJ combustion-service input per MJ heat preserves the inspected ecoinvent 3.6 cut-off oil CHP heat allocated fuel mass. It reproduces both separately recorded source fossil CO2 components. This is an allocation reconstruction, not an inferred physical efficiency, unallocated furnace substitution or an added electricity coproduct credit.

Retain the source heat CCS 9% input penalty and 90% capture of combustion CO2 only. Native combustion emits 0.078 kg/MJ in urban air and separately 0.00061791 kg/MJ from limestone flue-gas treatment in unspecified air. The limestone CO2 remains unchanged and uncaptured, matching the original heat CCS convention. Capture demand and the paired negative urban-air fossil CO2 exchange are both 0.02930278387157407 kg/MJ useful heat.

Use the complete CLIC hard-coal post-combustion capture, 200 km pipeline and storage at 1000 m as the existing oil CCS model’s screening proxy. Oil-specific flue-gas composition, reagent demand, energy requirement, capture-plant scale, emissions and score differences are not established. Preserve the complete capture chain and native power-plant fuel, infrastructure, flue-gas treatment, emissions and residue inventory once. No new oil-specific performance correction or recovery credit is invented.

A fixed German allocated-heat reference prevents regional substitution of a different combustion or allocation basis while keeping the capture credit fixed. Geography, historical plant fleet, source allocation, technology, vintage and upstream background differ. The original 3.5 workbook credit is not used as a quantity witness for the inspected 3.6 heat allocation. Full real TIAM and combined-fuels qualification remain pending.
